handoffs.owner: GDF3 Game Feel / Feedback / Sensorimotor Coupling
questions: How do action-response timing, feedback, correction, legibility and control coupling alter perceived/experienced feel without turning subjective experience into Game authority?
How do hit-confirm, response latency, audiovisual/haptic feedback and recovery cues expose authoritative action/consequence relations?
How do timing windows, rhythm, anticipation, cadence, tempo and pacing become challenge-relevant without collapsing to reaction time?
How do temporal horizons transform failure/recovery and mastery claims?
How do topology, traversal, visibility, reachability, scale and spatial recovery routes alter challenge and failure?
Which spatial relations are structural versus controller-relative access projections?
How do adaptive opponent policies, nontransitivity, counterplay, equilibrium, balance and team interaction structure challenge without becoming one difficulty rating?
How are individual/team capability claims attributed under strategic interdependence?
Human evidence is required for felt difficulty, frustration, competence, flow, learning and subjective value; Game structural evidence cannot substitute.
Community/institutional recognition can define legitimate criteria/categories but remains distinct from capability mastery by identity.
